model.name: secretCode hardening — hash+salt at rest, rate-limit/lockout, never-logged (device-link auth)
model.description: SECURITY FINDING: secretCode is stored PLAINTEXT and UNHASHED (4 digits) on prod, and it gates device-linking. Harden it: hash+salt at rest, rate-limit/lockout on verify, never logged, and consider a second factor for device-link. Same identity/auth family as R40.13/R40.14.
